metadata.question: On July 20, 2025 at 10:44 am local time, was there a volcanic eruption in Halema‘uma‘u Crater, the summit caldera of Hawaii’s Kīlauea volcano?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Halema'uma'u Crater, Kīlauea volcano, Hawaii (~19.4069°N, -155.2834°W) - Date: July 20, 2025, 10:44 am local time (Hawaii is UTC-10, so 20:44 UTC) - Collection: For volcanic eruption detection, I should use: * Thermal anomaly detection: MODIS Terra/Aqua or VIIRS * Landsat 8/9 thermal bands * Sentinel-2 for smoke/ash if available - Since this is a specific time (10:44 am local), I need to check multiple satellite passes around that time 2. Masking strategy: - For volcanic eruption detection, I do NOT want to mask clouds completely as they might be volcanic plumes - Focus on thermal anomalies (high brightness temperature) which indicate lava/eruption - Use thermal bands: MODIS bands 21-22, Landsat bands 10-11, VIIRS I-band 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid detection (A): Significant thermal anomaly detected (temperature spike above baseline) - No detection (B): Normal temperature readings, no anomaly - C1: No images available for that specific date/time - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels (unlikely for thermal data unless completely cloudy) - C3: Calculation error Note: July 20, 2025 is in the future from my knowledge cutoff, but I'll write code to check what data exists. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Halemaumau Crater location const crater = ee.Geometry.Point([-155.2834, 19.4069]); const craterBuffer = crater.buffer(500); // 500m buffer around crater center // July 20, 2025, 10:44 am HST = 20:44 UTC on July 20, 2025 // Check a window around this time const targetDate = '2025-07-20'; const startDate = '2025-07-19'; const endDate = '2025-07-21'; console.log('Searching for volcanic eruption evidence on July 20, 2025...'); // Try multiple thermal data sources // 1. MODIS Terra (morning pass ~10:30 am local) const modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(crater); const modisCount = modis.size().getInfo(); console.log('MODIS Terra images found:', modisCount); // 2. Landsat 8/9 thermal const landsat9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(crater); const landsat8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(crater); const l9Count = landsat9.size().getInfo(); const l8Count = landsat8.size().getInfo(); console.log('Landsat 9 images:', l9Count, '| Landsat 8 images:', l8Count); // 3. Sentinel-2 for visual confirmation const s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(crater); const s2Count = s2.size().getInfo(); console.log('Sentinel-2 images:', s2Count); // Check if any data exists if (modisCount === 0 && l9Count === 0 && l8Count === 0 && s2Count === 0) { console.log('No satellite data available for July 20, 2025.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Analyze MODIS thermal data if available if (modisCount > 0) { const modisImg = modis.first(); const lstDay = modisImg.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // Convert to Celsius const thermalStats = lstDay.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.max(), sharedInputs: true }).combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: craterBuffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const meanTemp = thermalStats['LST_Day_1km_mean']; const maxTemp = thermalStats['LST_Day_1km_max']; const pixelCount = thermalStats['LST_Day_1km_count']; console.log('Crater thermal stats (MODIS):'); console.log(' Mean temp:', meanTemp ? meanTemp.toFixed(2) : 'null', 'C'); console.log(' Max temp:', maxTemp ? maxTemp.toFixed(2) : 'null', 'C'); console.log(' Valid pixels:', pixelCount); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid thermal pixels.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (meanTemp === null || meanTemp === undefined || maxTemp === null) { console.log('Thermal calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Volcanic eruption typically shows temperatures > 100C in thermal imagery // Active lava can be 700-1200C but satellite thermal bands saturate/average lower if (maxTemp > 80) { console.log('Significant thermal anomaly detected - consistent with eruption.'); console.log('A'); return; } } // Check Landsat thermal if available if (l9Count > 0 || l8Count > 0) { const landsatCol = l9Count > 0 ? landsat9 : landsat8; const landsatImg = landsatCol.first(); const thermalBand = landsatImg.select('ST_B10').multiply(0.00341802).add(149.0).subtract(273.15); const thermalStats = thermalBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.max(), sharedInputs: true }).combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: craterBuffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const meanTemp = thermalStats['ST_B10_mean']; const maxTemp = thermalStats['ST_B10_max']; const pixelCount = thermalStats['ST_B10_count']; console.log('Crater thermal stats (Landsat):'); console.log(' Mean temp:', meanTemp ? meanTemp.toFixed(2) : 'null', 'C'); console.log(' Max temp:', maxTemp ? maxTemp.toFixed(2) : 'null', 'C'); console.log(' Valid pixels:', pixelCount); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid thermal pixels.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (meanTemp === null || maxTemp === null) { console.log('Thermal calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (maxTemp > 80) { console.log('Significant thermal anomaly detected - consistent with eruption.'); console.log('A'); return; } } console.log('No significant thermal anomaly detected on July 20, 2025.'); console.log('B'); } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
